# gigahost_bgp_session (Resource)

A BGP peering session for an approved ASN. Session deletion is asynchronous server-side.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_bgp_asn" "example" {
  asn = "AS212345"
}

# The IP IDs for the session come from the server's ips list.
data "gigahost_server" "web" {
  hostname = "web01"
}

# Create a peering session on an approved ASN. At least one of
# ipv4_ip_id / ipv6_ip_id is required.
resource "gigahost_bgp_session" "example" {
  asn_id        = gigahost_bgp_asn.example.id
  ipv4_ip_id    = data.gigahost_server.web.ips[0].id
  redundant     = true
  default_route = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn_id` (String) ASN record ID (from `gigahost_bgp_asn.id`).

### Optional

- `default_route` (Boolean) Receive the default route.
- `ipv4_ip_id` (String) IP ID for IPv4 peering. At least one of ipv4_ip_id / ipv6_ip_id is required.
- `ipv6_ip_id` (String) IP ID for IPv6 peering.
- `redundant` (Boolean) Create redundant sessions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Session ID.
- `status` (String) Current session status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Find the session ID from the BGP overview:
#   gigahost bgp show
terraform import gigahost_bgp_session.example SESSION_ID
```
